shell_commands: timeout 300 npx jest --testPathPattern="chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance" --testNamePattern="runs onError and afterSession when beforeSession throws"

Add spec links for orchestrator tests in config-hooks spec to satisfy

about hook execution and error propagation.

Refs: #94
Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main
